final_qi.long_answer: Alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) is the major plasma protein produced by the yolk sac and fetal liver. In cases such as hepatoblastomas, AFP levels are often elevated. The mature protein contains 609 amino acids. This number is a characteristic structural feature of AFP, making it useful as both a diagnostic marker and for research into fetal protein production as well as tumor biology.
